{{recipe}}

'''''Meringata''''' (literally "meringued") refers to any type of [[Cookbook:Cake|cake]] or [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] with a meringue topping or meringue mixed into it such as ''meringata di limone'' ([[Cookbook:Lemon Meringue Pie|lemon meringue pie]]) or ''meringata di panna'' (meringue cream gateaux, pie, or other dessert). The name covers many entirely different confections, one of which is similar to [[Cookbook:Pavlova|''pavlova'']], an Australian/New Zealand meringue cake consisting of wheels of meringue layered with whipped cream. As a rule, ''meringate'', like most meringue confections, should be assembled a short time prior to consumption, otherwise the meringue will dissolve in the liquid in the filling.  

== Ingredients ==

=== Meringues ===
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] / 400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 16 oz (2 cups / 800 g) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]

=== Filling ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Crème Pâtissière|crème pâtissière]] 
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (75 g) [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]] 
* 5 oz (150 g) [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] (50 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) water
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Cream|heavy cream]]

== Procedure ==

=== Meringue ===
# Whisk the egg whites and sugar in a bowl over [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmering]] water until it reaches 120°F (50°C).
# Remove from the heat and continue [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipping]] until the meringue is cool and stiff.
# Line a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]] and draw two 10-inch circles on the paper.
# Using a [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|pastry bag]], [[Cookbook:Piping|pipe]] a spiral beginning in the centre of the circle and working outwards to form a disc about ½ inch thick.
# Repeat with the other circle.
# With the remaining meringue, pipe 20 small meringues using a star tip.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the meringues for 2–2½ hours at 200–225°F (110°C) until crisp but not brown. For a whiter meringue, bake at 180°F (80°C) overnight.

=== Filling ===
# Use the egg yolks left over from the meringue to [[Cookbook:Crème Pâtissière|make 1 cup of ''crème pâtissière'']]. Chill well.
#  Use the egg whites, sugar, and water to make an [[Cookbook:Meringue|Italian meringue]]. Refrigerate to cool thoroughly.
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the cream to medium peaks. [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in the 1 cup of cold pastry cream and Italian meringue. Refrigerate until ready to proceed with the assembly.

=== Assembly ===
#Spread one half of the filling on one of the meringue discs.
# Place the second disc on top and cover the second disc with the rest of the filling.
# Arrange the small meringues in concentric circles on top of the ''meringata''.
# Refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.
